items.title: Sections of an arbitrary direct sum over a quasi-compact open are the direct sum of the sections
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a quasi-compact open subset the sections of an arbitrary direct sum of sheaves of modules are the direct sum of the sections of the summands (author lemma at source lines 509-521, label lemma-section-direct-sum-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 523-535) takes a section of the direct sum, writes it locally as a finite sum of sections of individual summands, uses quasi-compactness to pass to a finite covering so that only finitely many summands occur, and then invokes the description of the sections of a finite direct sum (proof lines 524-534). The reduction to a finite index set by quasi-compactness is the content. H2.
